title_en: First female executive appointed since the establishment of the Korea Finance Training Institute
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] The first female executive has been appointed since the establishment of the Korea Financial Training Institute. On the 28th, the Korea Financial Training Institute announced that Kim Jin-heon, head of the comprehensive planning department, was appointed as the new vice president. Vice President Kim Heon-jin is the first female executive appointed since the establishment of the Korea Financial Training Institute, and has served for 30 years since joining the company in 1995. The new vice president's term is from August 1 to July 31, 2029. The Korea Financial Training Institute expected, "By appointing the first female executive, we will increase the diversity and inclusiveness of the organization and lay the foundation for innovation and generational change that will lead to future growth." title_ja: ナイキ、足マッサージしてくれるスリッパ出した… 「温熱・振動機能搭載」
summary_ja: 過去にも早いウォーミングアップと回復のためのウェアラブルフットウェアを披露したナイキが今回は温熱機能と振動機能を備えた先端スリッパを公開したとエンガジェットなど外信が27日(現地時間)報道した。この製品は、先に米国回復専門ブランドのハイパーアイス（Hyperice）とコラボレーションして披露した「ハイパーブーツ（Hyperboot）」と同様に、運動やトレーニング後の足の回復を助けるために設計された。各スリッパの上部に磁石のように着脱可能なこのモジュールは、熱と振動を発生させ、足の裏から筋肉を弛緩させ、休息と回復を助ける役割をする。ナイキは製品を使用するときに靴下を着用することをお勧めしました。エンガジェットはソックスにスリッパを履くスタイルが多少ぎこちなく感じられるが、発熱機能を使用する製品であるだけに実用的なアドバイスだと伝えた。
title_en: Nike releases slippers that massage your feet... “Equipped with heating and vibration functions”
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Nike, which has introduced wearable footwear for quick warm-up and recovery in the past, this time unveiled cutting-edge slippers with heating and vibration functions, foreign media such as Engadget reported on the 27th (local time). The product released this time is the 'Nike Air Zoom Hyperslide'. This product, like the 'Hyperboot' previously introduced in collaboration with the American recovery brand Hyperice, is designed to help feet recover after exercise or training. The core of the product is the 'Hyperslide Pods' that are mounted on shoes. This module, which can be attached and detached like a magnet on the top of each slipper, generates heat and vibration to relax the muscles starting from the sole of the foot and helps with rest and recovery. The temperature can be adjusted in the range of approximately 42.8 to 47.2 degrees, and supports 3-level temperature control and 3-level vibration modes. Nike recommends wearing socks when using the product. Engadget said that wearing slippers with socks may feel a bit awkward, but it is practical advice as it is a product that uses a heating function. Ford is linked to the Hyperice app via Bluetooth, and the temperature can be set in the app.

title_en: “AI from chip design to verification”… NVIDIA Advances Engineering Agents
summary_en: [ZDNet Korea] NVIDIA expands the scope of artificial intelligence (AI) agent utilization to professional engineering work. NVIDIA announced on the 28th that it has added PhysicsNemo and CUDA-X libraries to the 'NVIDIA Agent Toolkit' for engineering. Developers can use it to build AI agents that make physics-based reasoning and run complex simulations. The NVIDIA Agent Toolkit helps develop specialized AI assistants that connect industry-specific tools, models, and data. With this update, AI agents can now directly call and utilize physics models, numerical solvers, and quantum chemistry technology. PhysicsNemo provides the technology needed to learn and deploy AI physics models. It converts the model structure into a tool that can be called directly in engineering work and supports use in complex design and simulation. CUDA-X includes the iterative sparse solver 'NVIDIA cuISS' and the direct sparse solver 'NVIDIA cuDSS'. It is a technology that accelerates large-scale linear calculations that occur during physics and engineering simulation and electronic design automation with a graphics processing unit (GPU). The quantum chemistry library 'NVIDIA cuEST' can apply high-precision quantum chemistry simulations to large-scale production tasks...
